figures.title: Figure 1
figures.llm_description: FIG. 1. (a) The crystal structure of 1T and 1T′ phase of TMD MX2. The primitive unit cells of the 1T and 1T′ phases are repre-sented as the red rhombic and green rectangle, respectively. The 1T′ phase can be viewed as a distorted 1T. The key structure difference is the nonequal M-M interatomic distance among two adjacent M rows, i.e., d1/d2 <1 in 1T′ phase. figures.title: Figure 2
figures.llm_description: FIG. 2. The relative total energy landscape of (a) CrS2, (b) CrSe2, and (c) CrTe2 under biaxial strain conditions. The two energy valleys correspond to the 1T′ NM- and FM-CDW states, respectively.

figures.title: Figure 3
figures.llm_description: FIG. 3. (a) and (b) show the DOS results of 1T′ FM- and NM-CDW states of CrS2 and their partial charge density within the energy range of −1.5 to 0 eV. The M-M dimer bonds cannot be observed between Cr atoms in the 1T′ FM-CDW phase, whereas it could be observed in the 1T′ NM phase. (c) The schematic dia-gram summarises the formation mechanisms of 1T′ FM-CDW and NM-CDW phases in CrS2. The red and black arrows represent the magnetic orientation. The red dot line represents the Cr-Cr dimer bonds. T

figures.title: Figure 4
figures.llm_description: FIG. 4. The DOS and partial charge density results within electronic energy level range from −1.5 to 0 eV for (a) 1T′ MnS2, (b) MnSe2, and (c) MnTe2. The Mn-Mn dimer bonds can be observed, which should be the formation mechanism of the 1T′ FM-CDW phase in MnX2. Note that this is different from the CrX2 (Fig. 3).

figures.title: Figure 5
figures.llm_description: FIG. 5. An overview of the 1T′ FM-CDW and NM-CDW phases in group IV, V, VI, and VII TMDs and the formation mechanisms of 1T′ FM-CDW phases. See main text for details. The blue dot box represents the M-M dimer formation, and the red dot box represents the direct exchange to superexchange transition.

figures.title: Figure 6
figures.llm_description: FIG. 6. Charge doping induced reversible phase transition be-tween 1T′ NM and FM CDW phases in CrS2. (a) and (b) show the variation of lattice constants a and b under different electron and hole doping levels. The black arrows show the doping sequence. (c) The phase transition energy barrier between the 1T′ NM and FM state under different charge doping.
